messages.subject: Re: Localhost waiting
parts:
Dear all, I finally solved the problem, the path to the brew package was wrong. I installed the package in the "/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library" folder as indicated in the RapacheInfo output and It works. 
Thanks to all!!!

El martes, 11 de junio de 2013 16:40:53 UTC+2, Luis Rodriguez-Lado escribió:
Dear colleagues,

I have a problem with the configuration of rapache within mac (OS X 10.8.4). I installed correctly R and rapache. I can correctly run SetHandler (r-info) and  RFileHandler arguments (just tried with test.R and helloworld.R and both work perfectly). However, when I modify my httpd.conf to pass the brew function to rhtml files, the localhost seems to start but freezes and I just can read the "localhost waiting" message in the bottom of the browser. 
The handler I try to include is in the classical form 

  <Directory /Library/WebServer/Documents/test/brew>
    SetHandler r-script
    RHandler brew::brew
  </Directory>/test/brew>

Since my DocumentRoot is at /Library/WebServer/Documents/ , also tried the path  <Directory /test/brew> but the result is the same. 

Other settings of my https.conf are:

ServerRoot "/usr" (ServerRoot "/Library/WebServer/Documents" does not work)
DocumentRoot "/Library/WebServer/Documents"

Do you have any idea to solve the problem of my rapache configuration?

Thanks in advance

Luis
